_comment: One pet as Adopt-a-Pet's pets_at_shelter is understood to return it, using only the field names recorded on issue #40. Deliberately carries NO weight, microchip_id, numerical_age, adoption_fee, hypoallergenic, coat_pattern, secondary_color, tertiary_color, or bonded-pair keys — their absence is the point, since it exercises the hydrator's declared-default precedence for a provider that simply does not have them. good_with_cats is likewise absent: the reference client never read it, so we do not get to assume it exists.
description: Marigold came in as a stray and has been the office greeter ever since.
